license_required.quote: A person may not: (a) Practice engineering unless the person is licensed or exempt from licensure under this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Florida Engineers Management Corporation (on behalf of the Board of Professional Engineers)
issuing_authority.quote: The management corporation shall issue a license to any applicant who the board certifies is qualified to practice engineering

name.quote: There is created in the department the Board of Professional Engineers.

type.quote: There is created in the department the Board of Professional Engineers. The board shall consist of 11 members, 9 of whom shall be licensed engineers

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Business and Professional Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: the board shall certify for licensure any applicant who has submitted proof satisfactory to the board that he or she is at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: A person shall be entitled to take an examination for the purpose of determining whether she or he is qualified to practice in this state as an engineer if the person is of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduate of an approved engineering science curriculum of 4 years or more, or an approved engineering technology curriculum of 4 years or more
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate from an approved engineering science curriculum of 4 years or more in a school, college, or university which has been approved by the board; or Is a graduate of an approved engineering technology curriculum of 4 years or more in a school, college, or university which has been approved by the board.

accrediting_body.value: Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology, Inc. (ABET EAC)
accrediting_body.quote: an applicant who seeks licensure by examination has passed the fundamentals examination when such applicant has received a doctorate degree in engineering from an institution that has an undergraduate engineering program that is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology, Inc.

degree_level.quote: Is a graduate from an approved engineering science curriculum of 4 years or more in a school, college, or university which has been approved by the board

school_approval_basis.quote: a school, college, or university which has been approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Is a graduate from an approved engineering science curriculum of 4 years or more in a school, college, or university which has been approved by the board

required.quote: Satisfies the requirements of s. 471.013(1)(a)1. and has a record of at least 4 years of active engineering experience of a character indicating competence to be in responsible charge of engineering

experience_source.quote: Satisfies the requirements of s. 471.013(1)(a)1. and has a record of at least 4 years of active engineering experience of a character indicating competence to be in responsible charge of engineering

duration.value: 4 years (engineering science curriculum) or 6 years (engineering technology curriculum)
duration.quote: Satisfies the requirements of s. 471.013(1)(a)1. and has a record of at least 4 years of active engineering experience of a character indicating competence to be in responsible charge of engineering; or Satisfies the requirements of s. 471.013(1)(a)2. and has a record of at least 6 years of active engineering experience

kind.value: active engineering experience in responsible charge
kind.quote: active engineering experience of a character indicating competence to be in responsible charge of engineering

exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Examination
exams.notes: Must be passed before taking principles and practice exam. Board may deem doctorate holders who taught full-time for 3+ years as having passed. Applicants allowed 3 attempts; after 3 failures must complete additional college-level education or board-approved review course.
exams.quote: A person shall be entitled to take an examination for the purpose of determining whether she or he is qualified to practice in this state as an engineer intern if she or he is in the final year of, or is a graduate of, an approved engineering curriculum

exams.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering (PE) Examination
exams.notes: Cannot take until fundamentals exam is passed. Applicants allowed 3 attempts before additional education required.
exams.quote: A person shall not be entitled to take the principles and practice examination until that person has successfully completed the fundamentals examination.

interval_years.quote: The board shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: The board shall require a demonstration of continuing professional competency of engineers as a condition of license renewal or relicensure.

hours_per_period.quote: Every licensee must complete 9 continuing education hours for each year of the license renewal period, totaling 18 continuing education hours for the license renewal period.

period_years.quote: totaling 18 continuing education hours for the license renewal period

value: 1 hour relating to Chapter 471 and the rules adopted under it
1 hour relating to professional ethics
4 hours relating to the licensee's area of practice
Remaining hours may relate to any topic pertinent to the practice of engineering
topical_requirements.quote: One hour must relate to this chapter and the rules adopted under this chapter. One hour must relate to professional ethics. Four hours must relate to the licensee's area of practice. The remaining hours may relate to any topic pertinent to the practice of engineering.

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for a license by endorsement an applicant who: (a) Qualifies to take the fundamentals examination and the principles and practice examination as set forth in s. 471.013, has passed a United States national, regional, state, or territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent... or (b) Holds a valid license to practice engineering issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of the license were substantially the same as the licensure criteria that existed in this state at the time the license was issued.

requirements.value: Applicant must either: (a) qualify for and pass a substantially equivalent US national/regional/state/territorial exam and meet experience requirements; or (b) hold a valid license from another state/territory where criteria were substantially the same. Board deems 10 years of valid PE license as equivalent to the FE exam, and 15 years as equivalent to both FE and PE exams. Temporary registration also available for out-of-state engineers for specific projects up to 1 year.
requirements.quote: Holds a valid license to practice engineering issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of the license were substantially the same as the licensure criteria that existed in this state at the time the license was issued.

national_certification.quote: The board shall adopt rules that are substantially consistent with the most recent published version of the Continuing Professional Competency Guidelines of the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of s. 455.227(1), s. 471.025, s. 471.031, or any other provision of this chapter or rule of the board or department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of s. 455.227(1), s. 471.025, or s. 471.031, or any other provision of this chapter or rule of the board or department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to procure a license to practice engineering by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure a license to practice engineering by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by another state, territory, or country for any act that would constitute a violation of this chapter or chapter 455.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice engineering revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country, for any act that would constitute a violation of this chapter or chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, a crime that directly relates to the practice of engineering or the ability to practice engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of engineering or the ability to practice engineering.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report or record known to be false, or willfully failing to file a required report or record, or impeding such filing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record that the licensee knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud or deceit, negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in fraud or deceit, negligence, incompetence, or misconduct, in the practice of engineering.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating chapter 455 (Business and Professional Regulation: General Provisions).
Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affixing or permitting to be affixed the licensee's seal, name, or digital signature to final documents not prepared by the licensee or under the licensee's responsible supervision, direction, or control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affixing or permitting to be affixed his or her seal, name, or digital signature to any final drawings, specifications, plans, reports, or documents that were not prepared by him or her or under his or her responsible supervision, direction, or control.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing building code inspection services under s. 553.791 without satisfying the required insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing building code inspection services under s. 553.791, without satisfying the insurance requirements of that section.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The practice of, or the offer to practice, engineering by licensees or offering engineering services to the public through a business organization... is permitted only if the business organization is qualified by an engineer licensed under this chapter

definition_quote.value: Engineering includes the term 'professional engineering' and means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of engineering works and systems, planning the use of land and water, teaching of the principles and methods of engineering design, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction for the purpose of determining in general if the work is proceeding in compliance with drawings and specifications, any of which embraces such services or work, either public or private, in connection with any utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work systems, projects, and industrial or consumer products or equipment of a mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or thermal nature, insofar as they involve safeguarding life, health, or property
definition_quote.quote: "Engineering" includes the term "professional engineering" and means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, and design of engineering works and systems, planning the use of land and water, teaching of the principles and methods of engineering design, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction for the purpose of determining in general if the work is proceeding in compliance with drawings and specifications
